theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_tg_chart_gradient
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ g : Eucl P → Eucl P, Measurable g ∧ (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ L) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (Φ '' Ω)), ∀ w ∈ Ω, Φ w = y → g y ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap ∧ ∀ v ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ Φ w).toLinearMap, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (y + s • v)) (inner ℝ (g y) v) 0
